info.description: API for deploying applications to regional k3s clusters
info.title: vora-cloud API

post.description: Create a new API key (Admin only)

delete.description: Delete an API key by ID (Admin only)

post.description: Deploy an application to the region named in the request. The response carries the deployment ID, <region>/<name>.

delete.description: Delete an application and everything it created. The ID is <region>/<name>; send the slash as %2F.

parameters.description: Deployment ID, <region>/<name> with the slash as %2F
parameters.name: id

get.description: Get the rollout status of an application. The ID is <region>/<name>; send the slash as %2F.

parameters.description: Deployment ID, <region>/<name> with the slash as %2F
parameters.name: id

post.description: Login with email and password to get access token
Logout user and revoke refresh token

get.description: Get information about the currently logged in user

post.description: Refresh access token using refresh token from cookie or body
Register a new user with name, email and password

get.description: Check if the server is healthy

post.description: Create a project owned by the caller. The slug names the project's namespace and host, so it is unique across all users.

delete.description: Tear down the project's namespace in its region, then delete the project and its deployments

post.description: Run an existing image for the project as a new deployment. The response is the deployment record; poll it until its status is ready or failed.

put.description: Stored encrypted; it applies on the next deployment or redeploy

post.description: Run the project's latest image again, which also applies changed environment variables
Deploy the image of an earlier deployment that became ready, as a new deployment
post.summary: Roll back to an earlier deployment

get.description: List all API keys for the current user

post.description: Create a new API key for the current user

delete.description: Delete a user API key by ID
